extraction.Name: Charles Moore
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 19, 1920, by the Register of Deeds, Lurdo, South Dakota
extraction.Buyer: Deed dated May 13, 1926 conveys the land to C. Owen for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739699 issued; Northeast quarter and Southwest quarter, Section 25, township 38, north range 26. The receipt was signed by the allottee on April 3, 1920. Evidence of fraud was shown and the land was reconveyed to Mr. Moore. It is now held by [document incomplete]. Restricted deed in the name of Millie Moore, wife of Charles, and his daughter, Angelique, having been purchased from Mr. Moore through the Department.
